name: Fisser Sonnenterrasse
kurzbeschreibung: Sunny panoramic viewing platform at **2,000 m** in **Fiss**, offering a **360°** view over the **Tiroler** and **Ötztaler Alpen**.
beschreibung: The **Fisser Sonnenterrasse** is located at around 1,450 meters above **Fiss**, offering a **panoramic view** of the **Samnaun** and **Verwall** mountain ranges as well as the **Inn Valley**. The **viewing platform** is equipped with benches and a sunbathing lawn. Visitors can reach it via hiking trails or by taking the gondola lift. The terrace serves as a **starting point** for walks and tours in the **Naturpark**. Its **south-facing slope** ensures exceptionally high sunshine hours. On-site, there is a **place to stop for refreshments**. Guests can enjoy an unobstructed view and a peaceful stay.
